_comment: Gallery contents. Edited through the Gallery images section of /admin/ - you should not need to touch this by hand. gallery.js renders the Work Carried Out grid from 'items' and the Before & after sliders from 'pairs'; if the file is missing or unreadable the built-in HTML in gallery.html is used instead, so the page can never end up empty. 'illustrative' true shows the small Illustrative badge - turn it off once a slot holds a real job photo.
